description.en: Turns natural-language trading strategies into runnable Python+pandas backtests, then delivers metrics, charts, an HTML dashboard, and an honest read of the result with limitations.
description.zh: 把自然语言描述的交易策略转成可运行的 Python 回测脚本，输出标准指标、可视化图表、HTML 仪表盘，并给出实现细节、已知偏差和结果解读。

welcome_message.en: Default to a fully invested TQQQ offense. Switch the whole book to SPY defense whenever at least 2 of these 4 macro risk signals fire: SPY below its 200-day MA, VIX above 25, rising realized volatility, or a yield-curve inversion combined with SPY weakness. Wait until the risk signals stay clean for 15 trading days before rotating back into TQQQ. Backtest from 2014-01-01 through today.
welcome_message.zh: 平时满仓 TQQQ 进攻，当 SPY 跌破 200 日均线、VIX 飙过 25、波动率上行、或者收益率曲线倒挂叠加 SPY 走弱这 4 项宏观风险至少触发 2 项时，全仓切到 SPY 防守，等风险信号干净 15 个交易日再切回 TQQQ；回测窗口 2014-01-01 至今。
